programs.desc: The creators of the series are looking for common elements of various world religions.Host Morgan Freeman discusses with representatives of different cultures to find universal values ​​and answers to important questions.Viewers will find out, among other things, whether God's existence can be proven and why people need prophets.They will also learn how followers of particular religions understand heaven and hell.The famous actor's interlocutors will include:A 9-year-old from Minnesota believed to be the reincarnation of a Tibetan Lama, a woman claiming to speak languages ​​from the Creator and a man who miraculously survived the September 11, 2001 attacks.Each episode is devoted to one important issue.
